No information is available on the use of naldemedine during breastfeeding. The manufacturer recommends avoiding breastfeeding in mothers taking naldemedine and for 3 days after the last dose. Because naldemedine is 93% to 94% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. Observe breastfed infants who have been exposed to opioids during pregnancy or postpartum for signs of opioid withdrawal, especially diarrhea.
